purpose: Trigger-boundary set for ugt-nextjs-design-setup. S* queries must route to this skill; N* queries must NOT (expected target noted). Rerun by giving a fresh model the plugin skill listing plus each query independently and asking which skill it would invoke/read first.
method: 3 independent judges, randomized order, full skill listing incl. superpowers + frontend-design distractors

baseline_result.method_note: Text-isolated: judges read a compiled listing (11 real skills + 7 distractors: 5 superpowers + frontend-design + impeccable), 14 queries each in a per-judge randomized order, expected answers never shown.
baseline_result.note: iteration 0: S-side 21/21 routed to ugt-nextjs-design-setup (incl. S6 sync mode and S7 no-keyword phrasing); N-side 21/21 did NOT route to it. The design-word traps held: N6 (landing เท่ ๆ ว้าว ๆ) went to frontend-design (2 judges) / impeccable (1) — never the org installer. The 3 secondary misses are other skills' boundaries, not this one's: N5 (เพิ่มกราฟ dashboard) → brainstorming twice instead of none — defensible, superpowers mandates brainstorming before feature work; N1 (database schema) → none once instead of ugt-nextjs-database-setup. No description change needed; optimizer loop terminated at iteration 0.
